home.title: Free PDF Tools That Never Upload Your Files | LocalDocu

mergePdf.title: Merge PDF Free — No Upload, Works Offline | LocalDocu

mergeDocx.title: Merge Word Documents Free — No Upload | LocalDocu

compressPdf.title: Compress PDF Free — Reduce Size Without Uploading | LocalDocu

pdfTools.title: All PDF Tools in One Page — Free, No Upload | LocalDocu
pdfTools.description: Merge, split, extract, delete, rotate, reorder and compress PDFs in one place. Everything runs in your browser — free, private, no account, works offline.

splitPdf.title: Split PDF Free — Separate Pages Without Uploading | LocalDocu
splitPdf.description: Split a PDF into one file per page in your browser. Nothing is uploaded — free, no sign-up, no watermark. Need a page range? Use Extract pages.
splitPdf.h1: Split PDF files without uploading them

extractPages.title: Extract Pages From PDF — Free, No Upload | LocalDocu
extractPages.description: Save selected pages (like 1-3,5) from a PDF as a new file, right in your browser. Free, private and offline-capable — the PDF never leaves your device.

deletePages.title: Delete Pages From PDF — Free, No Upload | LocalDocu
deletePages.description: Remove blank, duplicate or unwanted pages from a PDF in your browser. No upload, no account, no watermark — the edited copy is saved on your device.
deletePages.h1: Delete pages from a PDF locally

rotatePdf.title: Rotate PDF Free — Fix Sideways Pages, No Upload | LocalDocu

reorderPages.title: Reorder PDF Pages — Rearrange Free, No Upload | LocalDocu
